items.title: Understanding Weather Forecast Consensus with Spread and Confidence
items.content_text: Weather forecasts are built from multiple forecast models, and those models can produce somewhat different results. Some models provide a single deterministic forecast, while ensemble systems generate multiple possible outcomes. When the contributing forecasts agree closely, confidence in the forecast is generally higher. When they diverge, there is greater uncertainty about the expected outcome.
